title: 2012 World of Warcraft TCG: Champion Deck: Hogger Demo Quest: ATTACK! #15 (HP)
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Heavily played, see pictures.

This 2012 World of Warcraft TCG card features the Hogger Demo Quest and the ATTACK! design. It is a single-insert card with the card number 15, manufactured by Upper Deck. The card is part of the Demo Deck set and is an original from the 2012 season. 

The card is perfect for collectors and players of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game. It is a great addition to any collection and can be a valuable card for gameplay. The card is in great shape and ready for use in battles.
